The returning lair

A turn-based, single-player browser game. Explore eight rooms, complete one quest in each, and spend provisions on care or repair. All rewards are fictional; clicking a quest completes a symbolic game action, not a real-world assessment.

Lair map

Progress I/O

Saves are unencrypted and stored only when you download them. Loading replaces current progress. New game clears current progress; download a save first if you want to keep it. Reloading this page starts fresh.

Systems outside the game
Use Archangel management, IObot and rune tools, or the kerot software kit separately. They are not automatically loaded into an external game engine. The game provides no clinical, legal, spiritual, or emergency service.
